asl_hg.name: ASL-HG
asl_hg.attribution: Pranto, Md. Famidul Islam; Islam, Md. Rifatul; Akbor, Md. Ali; Ghosh, Nabonita; Alam, Md. Rahatun; Chaki, Sudipto; Islam, Md Masudul (2025), ASL-HG, Mendeley Data, V1, doi:10.17632/j4y5w2c8w9.1
asl_hg.participant_metadata: P1-P10 in original filenames; namespace retained, not inferred from appearance
asl_hg.condition_metadata: Publisher describes indoor/outdoor and varied lighting, backgrounds and hand orientations. No per-image physical hand, lighting, camera-angle or session labels are provided.

signalphaset.name: SignAlphaSet
signalphaset.attribution: Garg, Bindu; Kasar, Manisha; Kashyap, Achyut; Vats, Amber; Sharma, Gunjan; Hange, Aditya (2025), SignAlphaSet, Mendeley Data, V3, doi:10.17632/8fmvr9m98w.3
signalphaset.participant_metadata: Paper reports three participants; no per-image participant IDs. Do not invent signer IDs or mix this unidentified cohort across train/test.
signalphaset.condition_metadata: Paper reports 750 right-hand and 250 left-hand images per letter but explicitly says files do not identify hand. It also describes augmentation without per-file original/augmentation flags. Physical hand and capture conditions remain unknown; detector handedness is only an estimate.

massey.name: Massey MU HandImages ASL
massey.license: Author dataset terms, section 7 (2011): attribution and verbatim notice required; image resale prohibited
massey.attribution: Barczak, A. L. C.; Reyes, N. H.; Abastillas, M.; Piccio, A.; Susnjak, T. (2011), A new 2D static hand gesture colour image dataset for ASL gestures, Research Letters in the Information and Mathematical Sciences, 15, 12-20
massey.condition_metadata: Source filename codes identify five light directions. The original paper documents a fixed tripod camera perpendicular to the subject; individual hand tilt and numeric camera angles are not annotated. Physical hand and sessions remain unknown. Author terms permit attributed redistribution; this source is reserved for lighting evaluation, outside training.
